args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 18%, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west). v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failures before re-deploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, it's healthy again, and I opened a SEV2 incident.

- **Cause:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, had also been unhealthy in staging before it went to production.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in all three regions. A follow-up check shows checkout-api healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and has paged on-call. It says what failed, that the rollback was done, and that the cause of the v2.3.1 failures should be found before it's deployed again. I created the incident at the same time as the health check, so it doesn't mention the recovery. You may want to add that to the incident.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
